summary: Josh Lloyd and Jackson Gatlin of Locked On Rockets preview Houston's 2026/27 season. Last season the Rockets won 52 games even though Fred VanVleet (torn ACL) and Steven Adams missed big chunks of it. This offseason they added ball handlers in Marcus Smart, Bogdan Bogdanovic and rookie Bruce Thornton. The expected starting five is VanVleet, Amen Thompson, Kevin Durant, Jabari Smith Jr. and Alperen Sengun. VanVleet should be ready for opening night, but they expect his minutes to be managed. Reed Sheppard's role is a big question, and they project him at about 18 to 25 minutes. Sengun's ceiling is the key to the team, and Jackson predicts 54 wins.
